rules.sentence: In a poorly differentiated spindle cell tumor, negativity for S100 and SOX10 combined with patchy p63 and pan-cytokeratin positivity confirmed a diagnosis of sarcomatoid squamous cell carcinoma, excluding melanoma or sarcoma.
